gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-003 identifies the same failure in a10: a18 requires Lagrange-norm control on supp(ν), while a50 supplies control on supp(μ), with no assumed relation between the supports. It also recognizes that the resulting potential-range/Fourier rate is unsupported and proposes relating the normalization and evaluation domains.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The direct combination of a18 and a50 uses estimates on different, unrelated supports, so a50 does not control the supp(ν) quantity required by a18; consequently the asserted mixed-support rate and theorem are not established.

component_coverage.gold_component: The a18/a50 combination mismatches the support on which Lagrange norms are required with the support on which they are estimated, and therefore fails to establish the claimed mixed-support rate without a support relation.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction explicitly states the supp(ν) versus supp(μ) mismatch, absence of a support relation, the resulting unsupported potential-range/Fourier rate, and the required repair of relating the polynomial-normalization and Lagrange-evaluation domains.
